<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תמוז_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919515_theRebbe_764" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_9E_D7_95_D7_96_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919515_theRebbe_764__p010">
  <section v="27">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the emphasis on the glory of the latter Temple is because it is the root of all future revelations, including the resurrection of the dead.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">b)</t>
    <t s="2">And this is: "Great will be the glory of this latter house more than the first,"</t>
    <t s="3">for although in the future redemption there will be many matters, up to and including the resurrection of the dead which is the last of them all,</t>
    <t s="4">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="5">the main emphasis is on the glory of this latter house,</t>
    <t s="6">because the root of all the matters will be in the Holy Temple,</t>
    <t s="7">and from it they will be drawn into the world</t>
    <t s="8">(as above, section b).</t>
  </section>
  <section v="28">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section states that the first action of Moshiach is building the Temple, as it is the root of all subsequent matters, and concludes with a prayer for this to happen soon.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And this is also one of the reasons that the first action of Moshiach</t>
    <t s="1">(after he is established as Moshiach)</t>
    <t s="2">is the building of the Holy Temple74,</t>
    <t s="3">for this is the root of all the matters that follow.</t>
    <t s="4">And may it be His will, and primarily, that all this be very soon.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
